note: arm64/x64 are the website's own download addresses (cached by Cloudflare, served by site-worker/worker.mjs); source is where they come from: the latest GitHub release, whose files must be named Studio-CLI-arm64.dmg and Studio-CLI-x64.dmg. Bump version for each release so the cache refreshes. sig holds the release stamps installed apps check before updating (scripts/release.mjs writes them).
